fact: BEAC's report on e-money services in 2020 states that Règlement 04/18 on payment services has applied since 1 January 2019, with COBAC rules R-2019/01 and R-2019/02, and creates the établissement de paiement category that lets telecom operators and fintechs provide payment services.
title: Services de paiement par monnaie électronique dans la CEMAC en 2020
publisher: Banque des États de l'Afrique Centrale (BEAC)
